usage_rules.headings: Uppercase, tracking-tight, font-bold (700). Use for Page Titles and Section Headers.
usage_rules.subheadings: Uppercase, tracking-widest, font-medium (500), text-muted-foreground. Use for labels.
usage_rules.body: Regular weight, relaxed leading. Use for general text.
usage_rules.data: Monospace, font-normal. Use for Serial Numbers, QR Codes, Status Codes.

visual_enhancers.borders: Square edges (rounded-none). 2px borders on active elements. Corner ticks on cards.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.05) on background. Scanlines on video feeds.
visual_enhancers.animations: Instant transitions (duration-75). No bounce. Flash effects on success.

layout_strategy.spacing: Dense. p-2, p-4. Gap-2 or Gap-4.
layout_strategy.containers: Full width on mobile, max-w-7xl centered on desktop. Dashboard uses grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4.

buttons.base_style: rounded-none font-mono uppercase tracking-widest border-2 border-olive-500 bg-olive-500/10 hover:bg-olive-500 hover:text-white transition-colors duration-100

cards.base_style: rounded-none border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950/50 p-4 relative overflow-hidden
cards.decoration: Add a 4px colored strip on the left based on status (Green/Yellow/Red).

inputs.base_style: rounded-none border-b-2 border-zinc-700 bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:border-olive-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 font-mono

tables.header: border-b-2 border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900/50 text-left uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground p-3

libraries.icons: lucide-react (Use crisp, geometric icons like Shield, Target, Crosshair, Box, QrCode)

image_urls.usage: Use as a subtle background-image overlay with mix-blend-mode: overlay and opacity-10 on the main dashboard container.

offline_strategy_instructions.overview: The app must function 100% offline. Use IndexedDB via 'idb' library.
offline_strategy_instructions.logic: 1. App Load: Try fetching from API. If error, fetch from IDB. 2. Create/Edit: Try API. If error, save to IDB 'items' AND 'sync_queue'. 3. Online Reconnect: Process 'sync_queue' items to API.

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients. Use solid, matte colors.
Use 'Barlow Condensed' for all headings. Import it in index.css.
Ensure high contrast. White text on black background is default.
Dates must be formatted as 'DD MMM YYYY HH:mm' (Military Time) using date-fns.
Show a 'OFFLINE MODE' banner (Red/Yellow) when network is disconnected.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Install missing dependencies: `yarn add qrcode.react html5-qrcode jspdf jspdf-autotable idb`.
2. Update `tailwind.config.js` with the colors and fonts defined above.
3. Create a `Layout` component that wraps the app with the Offline status indicator and Navigation.
4. Implement the `InventoryContext` or `useInventory` hook to handle the Offline/Online logic abstractly.
5. Build the Dashboard with the Bento Grid layout.
6. Ensure the Camera Scanner handles permission errors gracefully.
